sentences.text:
Nandan Kumar Panda & Ors vs State Of West Bengal & Anr on
17 May, 2023
Author: Bibek Chaudhuri

Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
17.05.2023 Sl. No.10.
D/L. Mithun.
Ct.No.42.
Crr/3290/2022
Nandan Kumar Panda & Ors.
Vs. State of West Bengal & Anr.

Mr. Dipanjan Dutt, Adv.
Mr. Souma Subhra Ray, Adv.
Mr. Arpan Sinha, Adv.
Ms. Susmita Mondal, Adv.
...for the petitioners.
The petitioners are the husband and parents-in-law of the opposite party No.2.
Marriage of the opposite party No.2 was solemnized with petitioner Nos.1 about 12 years back.

On the basis of a written complaint, police registered Egra Police Station Case No.163 of 2020 dated 7th March, 2020 under Sections 498A/323/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
On completion of investigation police submitted charge-sheet against the petitioners.
The petitioners have now prayed for quashing of the said criminal proceeding.
Filing of the charge-sheet prima facie establishes the penal provision against the accused persons for which they should go for trial.
It is rightly submitted by Mr. Dutt that practically there is no specific allegation against the parents-in-law.
On the basis of omnibus allegation, the old parents of petitioner No.1 cannot be put to trial.

sentences.text: The instant revision is admitted qua the petitioner Nos.2 and 3.
Proceeding against the petitioner No.1 shall continue.
Petitioners are directed to serve notice upon the private opposite party under registered speed post with acknowledgment due and file affidavit of service within one week after vacation.
The State of West Bengal be served through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta.
The Public Prosecutor is requested to produce the case diary on the date of final hearing.
After service of notice, the petitioner is at liberty to mention the matter for disposal.

In the meantime, G.R.(E) 229 of 2020 be stayed as against petitioner Nos.2 & 3 till 15th August,
2023.

( Bibek Chaudhuri, J. )
